notes.title: The Barbarian and the Subterranean Caves version 1.87 is here!
notes.notes:
Hello all!

Today we've released small update for the game. It contains some fixes, as well as new small branch of plot. You can meet again with the girl you saw at the beginning of the game at some circumstances. Please be aware, that this branch contain erotic content, so you won't be able to reach it if you decided to turn it off at the beginning of the game.

And yes, small fix for our players, who refused to play the game because of the adult content, in this update you finally can turn it on. At the beginning of the game, just after the skills selection screen, the game will ask you, do you want to see erotic content or not. Using this feature will completely turn off the scenes with erotic content for this playthrough.

In order to find this small piece of content, you need to choose your starting skills wisely, because only certain combination of skills can fully unlock this branch :)

If you encounter any problems/errors when starting the game after update, you'll need to delete your previous save files, because, unfortunately, saves from the version 1.85 are not compatible with 1.87. You can find your save files in the following folder on Windows:

C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\The_Barbarian_and_the_Subterranean_Caves\BarbarianCaves.app\Contents\Resources\appdata\saves\barbarian_caves

or in some similar folder on other OSes.

Please be aware, that the Android version of the game is in the malfunctioning state right now. I'm trying to do my best to fix it, but, please, play updated game on Steam, not on Google Play, for now :)

Hope you'll like this small extra content.

Best regards,
Anton & NLB project team.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/490690/The_Barbarian_and_the_Subterranean_Caves/

notes.title: Update is coming!
notes.notes:
Hello all!

We are making the small update for the game. It tries to fix some gamedesign problems, and also you will get small storyline with the girl, which Ragnar saw at the beginning of the game. This story is really small (we were afraid to mess with this game, because the paths are so intertwined, that it was very easy to break anything), but we hope you'll like it anyway.

If you haven't completed the game yet, please be aware of the fact that the game saves will become incompatible after the update, because, unfortunately, we modified the tools we use for creation of our games, and the internals of the game drastically changed. So, please turn off the updates for a while, if you want to finish you playthrough, because after the update you had to start from the beginning.

Best regards,
Anton & NLB project team.

notes.title: Achievements hotfix
notes.notes:
We noticed that sometimes the game cannot connect to Steam properly at start, and therefore your achievement progress is not shown. But don't worry, we've already done small game update, which will try to re-send your achievements to the Steam when you run the game next time.

This should be very rare case indeed, but if you experience this, we recommend you to save the game, then shut it down and restart.

Please write in the comment section here, if you've experienced this problem. The method of getting achievements in this game is the same as for our previous game, and we never experienced it before, neither in our previous game, nor during testing.
